column4: frontier (inherent) — triage is a frontier task by this repo's own policy: the router has to be smarter than the routed, and a cheaper model classifying work it may later be handed is the conflict of interest the taxonomy exists to prevent. Not a spec gap; the requirement is structural.

frontier (both) — the template-applicability matrix is hand-maintained and names 18 of 36 templates, so a bootstrapped repo silently receives roughly the session-8 practice while the analysis still prints a score and reads as a success. Silent. Also carried no acceptance criteria until 2026-07-24. Escalated from standard by human decision on review.
frontier (spec) — issue describes the problem but does not pick a versioning approach; "Needs an ADR" is the spec gap. Specifying the scheme would make stamping and drift-detection wiring mechanical.

frontier (both) — silent failure (shallow analysis reads as thorough, holding cost/auth/migration constraints at once with no mechanical verification) AND under-specified (no acceptance criteria bind what "done" means). Rewriting the criteria shrinks what has to be derived; the silent half remains.
